newsitem.title: USA: No decision on refilling disaster stocks- Glickman.
newsitem.headline: No decision on refilling disaster stocks- Glickman.

text.p: Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Thursday there was no decision yet in discussions with lawmakers over using U.S. farm exports funding to replenish two disaster relief stockpiles.
"These are discussions," Glickman said when asked by reporters about the proposal to use funds from the Export Enhancement Program and from the PL-480 program.
"This is a decision they'll (lawmakers) have to make," he said. "It was an idea we had."

Glickman said the two food aid stockpiles were nearly empty and needed replenishment. It seemed appropriate, he said, to use exports promotion money since replenishing the stockpiles would bolster grain prices.
"Given the budget situation, appropriations are hard to get," Glickman said when asked if a direct request to replenish the stockpiles would be made.
